textures.noise: Apply a very subtle 2% opacity noise overlay over solid background sections (like the Secondary Dark Green sections) to add a tactile, premium feel.

grids_and_layouts.asymmetry: Avoid perfect centering for large content blocks. Use 5-column vs 7-column splits in a 12-column grid for visual tension.

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Sticky Glassmorphism Nav. Logo left, Links center, CTA right. Use Framer Motion to hide on scroll down, reveal on scroll up.

components.name: Kinetic Hero
components.description: 80vh+ height. Background image with gradient overlay. H1 uses line-by-line reveal via Framer Motion overflow-hidden spans. Large Primary CTA, Secondary Call Now button. Floating Trust Badges overlaid on bottom right using subtle parallax.
components.classes: relative w-full h-[85vh] flex items-center justify-start overflow-hidden

components.name: Trust Marquee
components.description: Slow, elegant, editorial marquee using react-fast-marquee. Very light gray background, dark green text. Content: Fully Insured • Professional Team • Reliable Service • Affordable Pricing.

components.name: About Section (Manifesto)
components.description: Split layout. Left: Sticky 'Numbered Manifesto' chapters. Right: Scrolling text and animated Framer Motion counters (500+ customers, 10+ years). Uses large images framed in pill or arched window shapes.

components.name: Services Grid
components.description: Dense Bento-style grid for 19 services. Cards are Very Light Gray, on hover slightly lift (-translate-y-1) and reveal a Soft Green bottom border. High-end Lucide icons in Primary Orange.

components.name: Why Choose Us & How It Works
components.description: 4-step layout using connected horizontal/vertical lines. Cards use a subtle Neumorphic inner shadow and Soft Green accents.

components.name: Service Areas
components.description: Visual Australia Map (SVG or high-res image) with floating marker pins. Grid of cards below: Residential, Commercial, NDIS, Aged Care, Real Estate, Body Corporate.

components.name: Gallery & Before/After
components.description: Masonry layout for the gallery with a smooth Lightbox. Custom Framer Motion slider for the Before/After interactive comparison (drag to reveal).

components.name: Testimonials
components.description: Luxurious slider. Large typography, 5-star icons in Primary Orange. Background can be Dark Green to break the visual pacing.

components.name: Floating Action Buttons
components.description: Bottom right corner. WhatsApp icon (Green), Phone (Orange). Add an animated ping effect to the WhatsApp button to attract attention.

motion.scrolling: Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. This is MANDATORY for the premium feel.
motion.scroll_reveals: Framer Motion 'whileInView'. Use { y: 40, opacity: 0 } to { y: 0, opacity: 1 } with a spring transition (stiffness: 100, damping: 20).
motion.hero_text_reveal: Split text into lines. Wrap each line in a <span className='overflow-hidden'>. Animate the inner text block from { y: '100%' } to { y: 0 } with a stagger.
motion.micro_interactions: All buttons must scale down { scale: 0.95 } on tap. Cards lift { y: -5 } on hover with increased shadow.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on primary orange meets 3:1 for large text. If not, darken the orange slightly for text, or use it only for large elements.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap major animations in a useReducedMotion check from framer-motion.

libraries: framer-motion (for scroll reveals, kinetic text, complex interactions)

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. FRAMEWORK: Use React, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. Ensure the app runs strictly on the client side for this single-page site.
2. SMOOTH SCROLLING: Wrap the main application in Lenis to enable premium momentum scrolling.
3. HERO ANIMATION: Implement the kinetic text reveal. Create a custom component that takes text, splits it by space/line, and animates it up using framer-motion.

4. WHATSAPP LOGIC: The contact form must not rely on a backend API. Construct a wa.me link with the form data (Name, Phone, Service, Date, Message) and use window.open to redirect the user to WhatsApp on submit.
5. FILE EXTENSION: Use `.js` or `.jsx` for all component files. Do NOT use `.tsx` or TypeScript syntax.
6. SPACING: Be excessively generous with whitespace. Use py-24 and py-32 for main sections.

7. COMPONENTS: Use raw HTML/Tailwind for structural layout to maintain creative freedom (asymmetry). Use Shadcn UI primitive logic for Accordions (FAQ), Inputs (Contact), and Dialogs (Gallery Lightbox).
8. ICONS: Use lucide-react. Standardize the stroke width to 1.5 for a premium, delicate look.
9. DATA-TESTID: Ensure every interactive element (buttons, form inputs, accordion triggers) has a data-testid attribute per the rules.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry to create visual tension.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism effects (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific properties to avoid breaking Framer Motion transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). It disrupts reading flow.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc. for icons. Use Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Missing categories or images must be handled gracefully without using generic placeholder text (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image URLs.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui. Custom logic should be built to match existing styles.
